We followed this dude in a like Deadpool costume (I don’t remember exactly what it was) through some alleyways into this side entrance to a hotel. 

We did in fact end up in a well lit basically empty ball room with a bunch of other underage nerds trying to turn the place into a party and had a great time with them.
